description: Use this when you need clean Markdown + metadata from a public URL (not raw HTML). Returns title, author, date, language, word_count, markdown, links. Better for RAG/summaries than fetch. Example: {url:"https://example.com"}. $0.002 USDC on Base via x402. Related: Whole documents (PDF/DOCX): /convert $0.03; page change alerts: /monitor $1.
name: read_url
